decisions.story_title: Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 exploited after public PoC for root RCE
decisions.reason: Observed exploitation of a CVSS 9.8 internet-facing Expressway flaw with root command execution, investigated by F6 Cyber Defense Center.

CVE-2026-76466.evidence: F6 Cyber Defense Center investigated the first observed case on November 19, 2026; attackers gained root-level remote command execution on internet-facing Cisco Expressway devices after a public PoC appeared.
